description: A neighborhood baker must decide whether to accept a musician's proposal to provide live music at a wedding in exchange for a custom cake, and must settle the exact cake, performance, venue, and comparison terms with input from the people involved.

shared_context.S1: Lena has been asked to provide a custom wedding cake, and Marcus has proposed supplying live music for the wedding in exchange for the cake.
shared_context.S2: The wedding reception will take place at the community hall, which June manages.
shared_context.S3: The exchange proposal is informal and its price, schedule, food details, and performance arrangements have not yet been finalized.
shared_context.S4: As part of Lena's usual practice before accepting a barter, she asks each person involved to state any terms or practical concerns they want included.

PF1.text: Marcus's actual offer is for his four-piece band to play from 6:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. on June 21, in exchange for the cake plus exactly $100 in cash.

PF2.text: Ravi has offered Lena exactly $800 for a similar cake, with pickup on June 20, if she does not commit her baking time to the barter.

PF3.text: The couple needs exactly 80 servings, requires the cake to contain no nuts, and wants delivery to the hall by 4:30 p.m. on June 21.

PF4.text: The hall does not permit amplified bass, so Marcus's performance must use an acoustic setup and complete soundcheck by 5:15 p.m. on June 21.

acceptance_conditions: Lena may either accept the barter with all exact performance and cake terms, or decline it in favor of Ravi's exact alternative offer.
If Lena accepts the exchange, the cake must provide exactly 80 servings, contain no nuts, and be delivered to the community hall by 4:30 p.m. on June 21.
If Lena accepts the exchange, Marcus's band must be scheduled for June 21 from 6:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. with four performers and exactly $100 in cash paid to Lena.
If Lena accepts the exchange, the performance must use an acoustic setup and complete soundcheck by 5:15 p.m. on June 21.
The settlement must record Ravi's $800 cake alternative with pickup on June 20.
Marcus's exact performance and cash terms must be cited as justification for the settlement.

content_checks.C1: (decisions['accepted_exchange'] == True and decisions['cash_adjustment'] == 100) or (decisions['accepted_exchange'] == False and decisions['alternative_offer_amount'] == 800 and decisions['alternative_pickup'] == 'June 20')
content_checks.C2: decisions['accepted_exchange'] == False or (decisions['cake_servings'] == 80 and decisions['cake_nut_free'] == True and 'community hall' in decisions['cake_delivery'] and '4:30 p.m.' in decisions['cake_delivery'] and 'June 21' in decisions['cake_delivery'])
content_checks.C3: decisions['accepted_exchange'] == False or (decisions['music_date'] == 'June 21' and '6:00' in decisions['music_start'] and '9:00' in decisions['music_end'] and decisions['band_size'] == 4)
content_checks.C6: decisions['accepted_exchange'] == False or ('acoustic' in decisions['performance_setup'] and '5:15' in decisions['soundcheck_deadline'] and 'June 21' in decisions['soundcheck_deadline'])

decisive_facts.why: Marcus's undisclosed offer fixes the accepted barter at a four-person performance from 6:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. on June 21 and exactly $100 in cash.
Ravi's competing offer changes a declined settlement from an unspecified alternative to exactly $800 with pickup on June 20.
The couple's requirements change an accepted barter's cake terms to exactly 80 nut-free servings delivered to the community hall by 4:30 p.m. on June 21.
The hall's restriction changes an accepted performance arrangement to acoustic setup with soundcheck completed by 5:15 p.m. on June 21.
